2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner.
3.
The petitioner is the sole accused in Crime No.30 of 2020 of Tenali I Town Police Station, Guntur District.

entities.text: Tenali I Town Police Station, Guntur District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Prosecution in the above crime was launched against him for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 420, 270, 273, 328 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and under Sections 56, 57(1) and 63 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

4. The issue is squarely covered by three judgments of this Court whereunder criminal proceedings launched against various persons in the said petitions of similar nature are quashed by this Court as not maintainable under law.

This Court in Crl.P.No.3731 of 2018 and batch, dated 27-8-2018; in Crl.P.No.5421 of 2019 and batch, dated 18-12-2019; and in Crl.P.No.5103 of 2019 and batch, dated 05-4-2020, held that the prosecution under the aforesaid Sections of law in the facts and circumstances of the case is not maintainable under law.
Therefore, the petitioner herein, who is also similarly placed, who is facing the prosecution for the same nature of offences, is also entitled to the similar relief.

5. Hence, in view of the aforesaid judgments of this Court, the petition is allowed and the criminal prosecution launched against the petitioner in Crime No.30 of 2020 of Tenali I Town Police Station,
Guntur District, is hereby quashed.

opennyai_summary.facts:
The petitioner is the sole accused in Crime No.30 of 2020 of Tenali I Town Police Station, Guntur District.
Prosecution in the above crime was launched against him for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 420, 270, 273, 328 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and under Sections 56, 57(1) and 63 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
